# College of DuPage Library

> The College of DuPage Library provides comprehensive catalog discovery, resource access, and library services for students and faculty.

The College of DuPage Library (codlrc.org) serves as the primary digital gateway for library resources, catalog discovery, and academic research support at College of DuPage. The library leverages modern discovery systems and collaborative networks to connect users with physical and digital collections.

## Key Topics

- College of DuPage Library
- WorldCat Discovery
- VuFind
- OCLC
- CARLI
- Catalog discovery
- Resource discovery
- Database access
- Learning Commons
- Library resources
- Web Voyage
- WorldCat Local

## Library Homepage & Services

- [College of DuPage Library](https://services.codlrc.org/): College of DuPage Library homepage with catalog discovery and resource access
